scope: Eight landing paths replaced with five text-only original generated illustrations. Four legacy v2 hero aliases intentionally share one composition. Other pending assets are not cleared.

entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: XENO creative software platform decorative website hero, widescreen 16:9. Create a new original architectural abstraction: a sculptural graphite ribbon curves through a dark charcoal studio, forming an open asymmetric passage with fine silver edge light and softly illuminated frosted glass planes. Premium restrained monochrome, subtle physically realistic roughness, deep blacks with readable shadows, elegant negative space for HTML text. Distinct original geometry, not any existing logo or artwork. No words, letters, logos, watermarks, UI panels, fake software screens or identifiable buildings. Full bleed single image, not a collage.
